column1: # The Lean worlds this build of Clean reads (docs/DECISIONS.md R38, R81).
# A world is identified by what pinned `lean` compares before it reads an
# `.olean` part: header version, flags and githash (module.cpp,
# `lean_compacted_region_read`); the header's lean_version string is
# informative only. build.rs measures each world's identity from the tracked
# fixtures named here; an identity is never written by hand. A row's fixtures
# must agree, and two rows may not share an identity.
# States (R38): oracle (exactly one, the `lean-toolchain` pin), historical and
# frontend-only are read without a declaration; measured is read only after
# `clean_olean::declare_environment_world`; canary is refused by name. Any
# identity no row carries is refused by name, and an environment reads one
# world.
# world
